messages:
mina: Heads-up: deploying v2.12.0 in ~7m. Goal: flip on routing/fastpath-v2 with controlled ramp. Plan: 8% internal-only for 10m -> 30% mobile + desktop for 20m -> 100% after 45m if steady. Pin router model to lyra-rc2@2026-03-20. Rollback triggers: sustained 5xx >0.8% for 5m OR p95 >+35% OR error surge on eu-west. cc @sre-oncall

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: rollout queued by mina at 1770001110. Commands queued:
```
/ff set routing/fastpath-v2 8% --cohort internal --exclude-region eu-west
/model pin router lyra-rc2@2026-03-20
/config set router.timeout.ms=300 --path fastpath-v2
```
I will post updates every 5m.

jorge: Request: make the 8% internal cohort only for infra and qa orgs (to isolate env). Also add a short circuit fallback: if error_rate spikes, route to fallback-route.

mina: Done. Cohort updated to infra+qa. Added automatic fallback policy.

deploy-bot: status @1770001410: fastpath-v2 at 8% (infra+qa), canaries healthy. Telemetry streaming.

lee: Seeing p95 +28% but 5xx 0.2%. CPU on canary-1 76%. baseline p95 here is 72ms -> now 92ms. Not hitting rollback yet but monitor.

sre-oncall: OK to continue. If p95 crosses +35% or 5xx >0.8% for 5m, auto-drain. Otherwise proceed with next step at +10m.

deploy-bot: 10m checkpoint @1770001710: advancing to 30% for mobile+desktop. Commands:
```
/ff set routing/fastpath-v2 30% --cohort mobile,desktop --exclude-region eu-west
```

mina: Pushing the change. Go slow on APAC capacity tomorrow but we excluded eu-west intentionally.

deploy-bot: status @1770002010: fastpath-v2 at 30%. Brief spike in 5xx to 0.9% for ~2m during ramp but dropped to 0.3%. p95 stable at +30%. No restarts observed.

jorge: Noting a small increase in prefix cache misses during the ramp. Capturing cache hit histograms for the cohort window.

sre-oncall: Continue to monitor; hold final 100% step until 45m stability window met. If errors recur, we'll pin back to lyra-stable@2026-02-25 and drain.

mina: Acknowledged. Will not proceed to 100% until 45m steady. Posting release notes draft for review.
